description: Search=Headers with a CRLF right boundary, the default ALL scope finding a header value, Scope=Body with filters that match the main request, Scope=Cookies reading the Set-Cookie line rather than a body decoy, and an Ord=2 match over the default scope (headers first, then the body, as LoadRunner's raw buffer orders them) all reproduce LoadRunner.
source: VuGen 26.1 Function Reference: web_reg_save_param (Search, Ord, default ALL), web_reg_save_param_ex SEARCH_FILTERS (Scope incl. Cookies, IgnoreRedirections, RequestUrl).
